description: This file contains test utility functions for the quiche project, including hex dump formatting, comparison of character arrays with error reporting, and URL IDNA support testing.

methods.name: HexDumpWithMarks
methods.description: Formats data as a hex dump with optional marks indicating specific bytes.

methods.name: CompareCharArraysWithHexError
methods.description: Compares two character arrays and reports differences with hex dump visualization.

methods.name: MakeIOVector
methods.description: Creates an iovec structure from a string view.

methods.name: GoogleUrlSupportsIdnaForTest
methods.description: Tests if URL IDNA encoding is supported correctly.
